```sql
WITH CharterSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, CharterNum
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CharterSchool (Y/N) = 1 AND CharterNum IS NOT NULL
),
SchoolScores AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWriteScore
  FROM satscores s
  JOIN CharterSchools cs ON s.CDSCode = cs.CDSCode
  WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
```
  GROUP BY s.CDSCode
)
SELECT cs.CDSCode, cs.CharterNum, ss.AvgWriteScore, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.AvgWriteScore DESC) AS Rank
FROM CharterSchools cs
JOIN SchoolScores ss ON cs.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode

  FROM frpm
  WHERE CharterSchool (Y/N) = 1 AND CharterNum IS NOT NULL
),
SchoolScores AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWriteScore
  FROM schools s
  JOIN CharterSchools cs ON s.CDSCode = cs.CDSCode
  JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
  WHERE sc.rtype = 'S' AND sc.AvgScrWrite > 499
  GROUP BY s.CDSCode
)
SELECT cs.CDSCode, cs.CharterNum, ss.AvgWriteScore, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.AvgWriteScore DESC) AS Rank
FROM CharterSchools cs
JOIN SchoolScores ss ON cs.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
ORDER BY ss.AvgWriteScore DESC

  SELECT CDSCode, DOCType
  FROM schools
  WHERE FundingType = 'Local'

  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM frpm
  WHERE Enrollment (K-12) - Enrollment (Ages 5-17) > ad.AvgDiff
)

    c.artist,
    COUNT(r.uuid) AS ruling_count,
    c.isPromo

    cards c

  artist,
  isPromo

  ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM MostRulings)

WITH badge_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    YEAR(Date) AS Year,
    COUNT(Name) AS Count
  FROM badges
  WHERE Name = 'Student'
  GROUP BY YEAR(Date)
)
SELECT 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN Year = 2010 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Year = 2010 THEN 1 END)) - 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN Year = 2011 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Year = 2011 THEN 1 END)) AS PercentageDifference
FROM badge_counts

sql:
WITH ConsumptionData AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.CustomerID,
    SUM(t2.Amount) AS TotalAmount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t2.Date BETWEEN '2012-08-24' AND '2012-08-25' THEN t2.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Amount2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t2.Date BETWEEN '2013-08-24' AND '2013-08-25' THEN t2.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Amount2013
  FROM 
    transactions_1k t2
  JOIN 
    customers t1 ON t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    t2.Date BETWEEN '2012-08-24' AND '2013-08-25'
  GROUP BY 
    t1.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  c.Segment,
  c.Currency,
  (cd.Amount2012 - cd.Amount2013) / cd.Amount2012 AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM 
  customers c
JOIN 
  ConsumptionData cd ON c.CustomerID = cd.CustomerID
WHERE 
  cd.TotalAmount = 634.8

WITH AwayTeamWinCount AS (
  SELECT 
    T2.away_team_api_id,
    COUNT(*) AS win_count
  FROM 
    Match AS T1
  INNER JOIN 
    League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id
  WHERE 
    T2.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND 
    T1.season = '2009/2010' AND 
    SUBTRACT(T1.away_team_goal, T1.home_team_goal) > 0
  GROUP BY 
    T2.away_team_api_id
)
SELECT 
  T1.team_long_name
FROM 
  Team AS T1
INNER JOIN 
  AwayTeamWinCount AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.away_team_api_id
WHERE 
  T2.win_count = (
    SELECT 
      MAX(win_count)
    FROM 
      AwayTeamWinCount
  )

WITH PlayerAttributesWithHeight AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        p.height,
        SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) AS total_heading_accuracy,
        COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS player_count
    FROM 
        Player p
    JOIN 
        Player_Attributes pa ON p.id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE 
        p.height > 180
    GROUP BY 
        p.player_name, p.height
),
AverageHeadingAccuracy AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name,
        total_heading_accuracy / player_count AS average_heading_accuracy
    FROM 
        PlayerAttributesWithHeight
)
SELECT 
    player_name
FROM 
    AverageHeadingAccuracy
ORDER BY 
    average_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH HighestFinishing AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, AVG(finishing) AS avg_finishing
  FROM Player_Attributes
  GROUP BY player_api_id
  ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
ShortestHeight AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  ORDER BY height ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
HighestHeight AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  ORDER BY height DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id THEN 'highest'
  WHEN T1.player_api_id = T3.player_api_id THEN 'shortest'
  ELSE NULL
END AS answer
FROM HighestFinishing AS T1
JOIN ShortestHeight AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
JOIN HighestHeight AS T3 ON T1.player_api_id = T3.player_api_id

```sql
    T1.player_api_id,
    AVG(T2.finishing) AS avg_finishing_rate
  FROM 
    Player AS T1
  JOIN 
    Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
  GROUP BY 
    T1.player_api_id
  ORDER BY 
    avg_finishing_rate DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
HighestHeight AS (
  SELECT 
    T1.player_api_id
  FROM 
    Player AS T1
  ORDER BY 
    T1.height DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
ShortestHeight AS (
  SELECT 
    T1.player_api_id
  FROM 
    Player AS T1
  ORDER BY 
    T1.height ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN T1.avg_finishing_rate = T2.avg_finishing_rate THEN 'highest'
    ELSE 'shortest'
  END AS answer
FROM 
  HighestFinishingRate AS T1
JOIN 
  HighestHeight AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
JOIN 
  ShortestHeight AS T3 ON T1.player_api_id = T3.player_api_id;
```

WITH loan_amounts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1996' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_1996,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_1997
  FROM 
    loan l
  JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN 
    client c ON a.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M'
)
SELECT 
  (amount_1997 - amount_1996) * 100.0 / amount_1996 AS growth_rate
FROM 
  loan_amounts

WITH LastDriverFinished AS (
  SELECT T1.time AS last_driver_finished_time
  FROM results AS T1
  JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
  WHERE T1.statusId = 1 AND T1.time IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY T1.position DESC
  LIMIT 1

  SELECT T1.time AS champion_time
  FROM results AS T1
  JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
  WHERE T1.statusId = 1 AND T1.time IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY T1.position ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  (CAST(LastDriverFinished.last_driver_finished_time AS REAL) - CAST(Champion.champion_time AS REAL)) * 100 / CAST(Champion.champion_time AS REAL) AS faster_percentage

sql:
WITH DriverPitStops AS (
  SELECT 
    d.forename, 
    d.surname, 
    SUM(p.duration) AS totalDuration, 
    COUNT(p.duration) AS pitStopCount,
    AVG(p.duration) AS avgDuration
  FROM 
    drivers d
  JOIN 
    pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId
  WHERE 
    d.dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
  GROUP BY 
    d.forename, d.surname
),
TopGermanDrivers AS (
  SELECT 
    forename, 
    surname, 
    avgDuration
  FROM 
    DriverPitStops
  WHERE 
    d.nationality = 'Germany'
  ORDER BY 
    avgDuration ASC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
  forename, 
  surname, 
  avgDuration
FROM 
  TopGermanDrivers

sql:
WITH MarvelSuperheroes AS (
  SELECT superhero_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
),
EyeColors AS (
  SELECT eye_colour_id, COUNT(superhero_id) AS count
  FROM superhero
  WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  GROUP BY eye_colour_id
),
RankedEyeColors AS (
  SELECT eye_colour_id, count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY count DESC) AS rank
  FROM EyeColors
)
SELECT eye_colour_id, count, rank
FROM RankedEyeColors
ORDER BY rank

WITH TotalCholesterol AS (
  SELECT SUM(T-CHO) AS TotalCholesterol
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18'
    AND Date LIKE '1981-11-%'
),
TotalCholesterolDecember AS (
  SELECT SUM(T-CHO) AS TotalCholesterol
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18'
    AND Date LIKE '1981-12-%'
)
SELECT (TotalCholesterolDecember.TotalCholesterol - TotalCholesterol.TotalCholesterol) / TotalCholesterol.TotalCholesterol AS DecreaseRate
FROM TotalCholesterol
JOIN TotalCholesterolDecember ON 1 = 1

WITH hydrogen_atoms AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'h'
),
label_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, label, COUNT(label) AS label_count
  FROM molecule
  JOIN hydrogen_atoms ON molecule.molecule_id = hydrogen_atoms.molecule_id
  GROUP BY molecule_id, label
)
SELECT label, MAX(label_count) AS max_label_count
FROM label_counts
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY max_label_count DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM molecule m

```sql
GROUP BY m.molecule_id;
```
